Identified as this saint because: A 19th-century Russian icon, described on Commons as «Святая Ольга» and filed under Category:Icons of Saint Olga and Category:19th-century icons of Russia. It is the crowned princess Olga, equal-to-the-apostles, baptised Helen, who died in 969 - the folder's saint. Commons describes it: Святая Ольга
